views.label: Automatic matching
views.note: Every new voiceprint, whoever detected the speakers, is compared against known profiles before anything reaches a human.

views.label: Unmatched -> cluster
views.note: Speakers with no confident match group into clusters across files, waiting for a human to name them.

views.label: Corrections stick
views.note: Unassigning blacklists the speaker from that cluster and profile; every later assignment path honours it.

cards.title: One voiceprint stage
items: Native vectors from this server's engine, or services/voiceprint_extractor.py on the cpu queue after a vendor, pyannote.ai or a post stage
Vendor voiceprints are never used; v0.8.0 swaps the extractor for a Rust one behind the same interface (#1231)

cards.title: Removing a voice is one implementation
items: services/speaker_cleanup.py: capture impact before the write, reconcile clusters, centroids and profile embeddings after the commit
Unassign (detach_from_cluster): leaves the cluster and its profile, blacklisted by default; the cluster and profile stay for everyone else

cards.title: Naming and corrections
items: promote_cluster_to_profile creates the durable identity; merge_clusters / split_cluster fix grouping first
Every assignment path skips a blacklisted speaker; only naming one speaker explicitly lifts its blacklist
